== Synopsis ==
Tempest is getting hotter and hotter. Rimuru and his friends went to a cool lake at the edge of the forest to play with all their might in their swimsuits. However, for some reason, Shuna and Shion are not happy with the swimsuit that Rimuru is wearing... On the contrary, Veldora, who is inside Rimuru, is playing chess and watching them play. The "Storm Dragon", who has never worn a bathing suit or played in the water, doesn't seem to understand their excitement.<ref>https://www.ten-sura.com/anime/tensura-nikki/story/no4</ref>

Ram was recognized as a prodigy from birth, ultimately saving the twins' lives, while Rem struggled with life. One day, Ram's horn was cut off by attacking cultists from the [[Witch Cult]], and Rem has felt guilty for it ever since. Back in the present, Rem regains her senses after [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] knocked her unconscious. Subaru, Ram and Rem run away from the [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarms]], but they encounter the puppy curse arts user behind the attack. To give the twins a chance to escape, Subaru stays put to fight the curse arts user, who has transformed into it's true form, a bigger and fearsome Wolgarm. Subaru stabs the Boss Wolgarm with his broken sword, but the attack is not effective. Just as Subaru is about to be killed, [[Roswaal L. Mathers|Roswaal]] arrives and burns the Boss Wolgarm and the remaining Wolgarms to death, which also removes the curses on Subaru. Back at the [[Roswaal Manor|mansion]], Subaru wakes up with Rem in the room, and Subaru tells Rem to keep on living for the future rather than to feel sorry for herself, causing her to fall in love with him. [[Re:Zero OVA|Memory Snow]] (Chronological) |Next = [[Episode 13]]}} '''Return to the Royal Capital''' (再来の王都) is the twelfth episode of [[Season 1]] of the [[Re:Zero kara Hajimeru Isekai Seikatsu (anime)|Re:Zero anime]]. ==Plot== The episode begins one week after the [[Witchbeast#Wolgarm|Wolgarm]] incident with [[Natsuki Subaru|Subaru]] and [[Emilia]] coming back from a morning outing with the kids from [[Arlam Village]]. After returning to the [[Roswaal Manor|mansion]], Emilia is summoned to the capital and the two are escorted to the capital by [[Wilhelm van Astrea|Wilhelm]] and [[Ferris]]. At the capital, Subaru sees the fruit merchant and buys a bag of appas. They then meet [[Julius Juukulius|Julius]] and the sight of him chivalrously kissing Emilia's hand causes a jealous reaction by Subaru. Subaru then witnesses a redheaded young woman, [[Priscilla Barielle|Priscilla]], being chased by the same three thugs who killed him in previous timelines. He goes into the alley to save her but the thugs run away when [[Rom|Old Man Rom]] appears looking for [[Felt]], whom Subaru says was taken away by [[Reinhard van Astrea|Reinhard]]. Later, Emilia insists that Subaru does not accompany her to the castle where the candidates for the upcoming [[Royal Selection]] will gather. However, the next day Subaru breaks his promise and accepts a ride to the castle in Priscilla's carriage as her appa servant. At the castle, Emilia is shocked to see Subaru with Priscilla who calls Subaru her manservant. As Emilia, Priscilla, [[Anastasia Hoshin|Anastasia]], and [[Crusch Karsten|Crusch]] wait, and to everybody's surprise, Reinhard introduces Felt as the fifth and final candidate. ==Characters== *[[Emilia]] *[[Natsuki Subaru]] *[[Milde Arlam]] *[[Rasphum]] *[[Petra Leyte]] *[[Lucas]] *[[Mild]] *[[Meina]] *[[Cain]] *[[Dine]] *[[Wilhelm van Astrea]] (debut) *[[Patrasche]] (debut) *[[Ram]] *[[Ferris]] (debut) *[[Rem]] *[[Roswaal L. The villager explains that the shore has remained unkempt due to the lack of villagers to assist with the cleanup efforts. The villager offers Frieren a [[grimoire]], claiming it was authored by the [[Flamme|Great Mage Flamme]]. Frieren, despite recognizing it as a fake, decides to accept the villager's cleanup request. == Synopsis ==
[[Thorfinn]], a boy living in [[Iceland]], longs for adventure and is eager to know more about the world. He dreams of a land of paradise called [[Vinland]] that he hears about from the adventurer [[Leif Ericson|Leif]], while he leads his peaceful life with this father [[Thors Snorresson|Thors]], a former warrior. One day, Thors saves a runaway slave and sets a series of events in motion. This is the story of a true warrior in an age of turmoil.

==Summary==
[[File:Thors and Thorkell defend in battle.png|thumb|left|220x220px|Thors and Thorkell defend in battle]]
The episode begins with [[Thors Snorresson]] waking up in a sunlit field surrounded by trees and grassy plains, where he is greeted from a distance by his wife [[Helga]] holding their infant child [[Ylva]]. When Thors walks to meet her, he realizes he is surrounded by corpses. Thors' comrade, [[Thorkell]], yells at him so he can regain his focus. Thors and Thorkell quickly cut down enemies who have boarded their ship, and it is revealed that they are participants in the Battle of Hjörungavágr in the year 987. Thorkell asks Thors if he is okay because of his initial lack of focus and Thors apologizes for daydreaming. == Synopsis ==
After having a dream involving his homeland and father, [[Thorfinn]] meets [[Askeladd]] on top of a hill and the two talk. A messenger for King [[Sweyn]]'s army informs Askeladd and his men that [[Thorkell]]'s raided Prince [[Canute]]'s base and captured him too. Delighted by this news, Askeladd kills the messenger and proclaims to his men that they'll rescue the captured prince.

== Summary ==
[[file:Thorkell throwing rocks to provoke the vikings.png|thumb|220px|left|Thorkell throwing rocks to provoke the vikings]]
As [[Canute]] doesn't give any order, the siege of London have not advanced and soldiers start to feel bored. Especially [[Thorkell]], who starts throwing large rocks at the vikings, insulting and provoking them to attack. Angry, the soldiers go to [[Ragnar]] and asks that they attack Thorkell, but Ragnar is against it, stating that when the time is right, Canute will give order. Inside his tent, Canute is praying. Ragnar goes inside and tells him that when winter comes, they will receive orders to withdraw.

Thorkell is annoyed as if the vikings don't attack, they can't fight. [[Asgeir]] tells him that they are just careful, since they are under the command of the Prince of Denmark. Thorkell is surprised to learn that Canute is here and starts grinning and laughing.

== Synopsis ==
[[Thorkell]] and his men are ambushed by [[Ragnar]]’s men in a dry forest. Taking advantage of their surroundings, [[Askeladd]] creates a smokescreen and orders [[Thorfinn]] to retrieve Prince [[Canute]]. Reunited with Thorfinn, Thorkell informs him of his relation to his father [[Thors Snorresson|Thors]].

{{Nihongo|'''"The Land on the Far Bank"'''|対岸の国|Taigan no Kuni}} is the twelfth episode of the [[Vinland Saga (anime)|''Vinland Saga'' anime]], produced by [[Wikipedia:Wit Studio|WIT Studio]].

== Synopsis ==
[[Askeladd]] sends a message for reinforcements and it is answered by the commander of the Welsh army [[Gratianus]]. The army transports Askeladd across the river to Wales and as they head to Brycheiniog, they ambushed by an unknown force.

== Summary ==
[[file:Askeladd sending a letter.png|thumb|220px|left|Askeladd sending a letter]]
[[Askeladd]] sees a man fishing and approaches him. He wonders if he is catching anything as the fish should be hibernating right now. The man explains that he doesn't care if he catches anything as his real job is operating the ferry. He tells Askeladd that his English is good, but he has an accent and guesses they are Danes. Askeladd then asks him how much it would cost him for the man to take them on the opposite shore. The man states its two silver pieces, but he can also take alcohol. He then laughs it would take him days to transport all, but Askeladd states he just needs to transport a letter. He then hands him the letter and tells him to delivery it to any one of the elders and to tell them its from Askeladd, son of Lydia. The man then tells him he will hurry up and leaves right away.

[[Ragnar]] looks for Askeladd, wanting to know why they stopped marching. [[Bjorn]] tells him that they need to keep quiet when [[Ear]] is working. Askeladd comes and Ear reports that the enemy got closer than yesterday and are one day away from them. Bjorn is surprised as yesterday they were two days away. Ear then reports he is hearing two horses on the hill on the left. Askeladd and the rest then sees the horsemen.
